name: Eiffel Tower
description: An iron lattice tower built for the 1889 World's Fair
facts: Originally intended to be temporary, 330 meters tall

name: Great Wall of China
description: A massive wall built across northern China
facts: Over 21,000 kilometers long, built over 2,000 years

name: Statue of Liberty
description: A colossal copper statue symbolizing freedom
facts: Gift from France, 93 meters tall, 225 tons

name: Taj Mahal
description: A white marble mausoleum built by Emperor Shah Jahan
facts: Built for his wife Mumtaz Mahal, took 22 years to complete

name: Christ the Redeemer
description: A colossal statue of Jesus Christ overlooking Rio
facts: 38 meters tall, Art Deco style, one of the New Seven Wonders

name: Colosseum
description: An ancient Roman amphitheater in the center of Rome
facts: Held 50,000 spectators, built with travertine stone

name: Big Ben
description: The great bell inside the clock tower at Palace of Westminster
facts: Actually the name of the bell, not the tower (Elizabeth Tower)

name: Leaning Tower of Pisa
description: A freestanding bell tower famous for its unintended tilt
facts: Tilts due to soft ground on one side, 56 meters tall

name: Pyramids of Giza
description: Ancient monumental tombs built for pharaohs
facts: Great Pyramid over 4,500 years old, originally 147 meters tall

name: Statue of Unity
description: The world's tallest statue dedicated to freedom fighter Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel
facts: 182 meters tall, surpassing Statue of Liberty
